name: Kourin no Machi, Lavender no Shoujo
original_name: 光輪の町、ラベンダーの少女
source:
It’s the beginning of summer in a normal town. Sousuke is your standard guy going to a normal school along with the typical cast of characters: the childhood friend living next door, the cute loli, the blonde twintail tsundere, the bespectacled discipline committee member… This couldn’t be anything but a slapstick school love comedy… until a girl with long black hair appeared. “I want to cry too…” Even though Hikaru is very strong, she is also weak at the same time. Everyone else is the same way – they are fragile when they are alone. That is why they seek bonding with others.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
平凡的小镇迎来了初夏。宗介只是个就读普通学校的普通男孩，身边也有恋爱喜剧中常见的角色：住在隔壁的青梅竹马、可爱的娇小女孩、金发双马尾傲娇，以及戴眼镜的风纪委员…这怎么看都只会是一部喧闹的校园恋爱喜剧…直到一个黑色长发的女孩出现。"我也想哭…"光虽然非常坚强，却也同时十分脆弱。其他人同样如此——独自一人时，他们都不堪一击。因此，人们才会寻求与他人建立羁绊。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
